files_modified.change: rendering_method gl_compatibility → forward_plus (Forward+ required for SDFGI/TAA/SSR/SSIL/volumetric_fog/DoF)

_build_environment rewritten: ProceduralSkyMaterial, ACES tonemap, SSAO+SSIL+SSR+SDFGI, volumetric fog, glow+HDR threshold, color grade, viewport TAA+MSAA 4x, sun contact shadows + PSSM cascade tuning
per-floor OmniLight3D accent lamp (palette-derived), amber embers above F47/F48/F55, reflection probes for F41-F44 trading floors, decorator-brief loader
GPUParticles3D dust motes per lift shaft (200 motes, slow drift)
rim_enabled + rim + rim_tint on worker dot material

renderer_required: Forward+ (Vulkan on Linux/NVIDIA, DirectX 12 on Windows). gl_compatibility silently no-ops SDFGI/TAA/SSR/SSIL/DoF/volumetric_fog.
fallback_path: Set rendering_method=gl_compatibility in project.godot AND V15_GFX_HEAVY=false in TowerRenderer.gd — keeps glow + SSAO + ACES + procedural sky + fog + contact shadows + MSAA + accent lamps + embers + dust + rim
